tests.name: A returning verified customer in a separate browser receives the same canonical identity
Optional MFA requires an explicit audited non-owner role decision and preserves branch scope
Optional recovery codes are issued once; opting into MFA revokes password sessions and old recovery codes
Owner MFA cannot be deferred and customer SMS cannot replace the admin password
Test identity provenance cannot be cleared by updates or washed by an import to another realm
Legacy auth grant is no longer executable by the authentication role
